# Line breaks

A hard break lives at the end of this line,  
so the next line is part of the same paragraph.

An address block, where every break is deliberate:  
Inkstone Project  
1 Markdown Way  
Somewhere

A soft break the author clearly meant to keep, because the paragraph is
wrapped by hand at a fixed width and rewrapping it would produce a noisy
diff on every save.

followed by its continuation.

Trailing paragraph.
